versions.changelog:
Initial release of the "tech-architect" skill.

- Provides end-to-end technical architecture design from requirements analysis to deployable solution documents.
- Covers technology selection, architecture design, data modeling, and deployment planning with step-by-step workflow.
- Emphasizes rationale for technology choices and progressive architectural evolution from MVP to scaling.
- Delivers outputs in Markdown format following strict naming and content guidelines.
- Includes special consideration for AI/LLM integration costs and alternative options.
- Enforces data modeling best practices, including indexing strategies.
